worked_solution:
We find the total displacement by calculating the definite integral of the velocity.

Let $d$ be the total displacement between $t=1$ and $t=5.$ Then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}d & ={\int }_{1}^{5}(\frac{3}{2}\sqrt{t-1})\,\text{dt} \\  & =(t-1)^{3/2}\,{|}_{1}^{5} \\  & =(5-1)^{3/2}-(1-1)^{3/2} \\  & =8-0 \\  & =8.\end{aligned}
$$
